text: 各位投資人、分析師，還有媒體朋友，大家午安，大家平安。我是聯詠科技的副總經理及發言人陳健興。今天非常歡迎大家再次來參加聯詠科技 2026 年第三季的法人說明會。今天在線上跟我們在一起的，有我們的聯詠的副董事長王守仁先生，還有我們的財務長陳涵真 Jane，還有投資的關係的處長 Tony。很高級能夠再一次跟大家在線上見面，我想今天的法說會會同使用中英文來進行。今天的會議的議程如下。
首先會有 Tony 這邊先用英文報告聯詠 2026 年第三季的結果。接下來會由我們的王副董針對第三季的結果再做進一步的說明，同時也會報告 2026 年第四季的展望。最後會開放時間給各位發問的時間。目前我們手上已經有收到一些的提問，我們會先用那些題目來回答，然後若有新的，我們會再整理，由 Tony 這邊來幫忙發問，再由我們王副董，還有我們的財務長這邊來回答。

Good afternoon, everyone. I would like to extend the warm welcome to everyone for joining Novatek 2026 third quarter online earnings call. This is David, vice president and company spokesperson, and I'll be the host for today's conference. Joining me on the call are our vice chairman, Mr. Steve Wang, our CFO Jane, and our IR director Tony. Thank you so much for joining in, and good to see you all online.

The agenda for today's event is as follows. First, Tony will report on Novatek's third quarter results in English. Following that, our vice chairman Steve will provide further details and insights on our Q3 results and also provide the guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026. Next, we'll proceed with the question and answers section. We have already received some questions from our investors, and if you have any additional questions, please feel free to submit them online. And Tony will organize and put forward the questions. And after that, our vice chairman Steve and our CFO Jane and myself will try to answer all your question in Chinese and later on translate them into English.
Now I'll hand over the time to Tony to report on our Q3 results.
Thank you, David. Good afternoon. This is Tony. So the first page take a look at our Safe Harbor Notice.
Next. Let's start with the consolidated sales. Third quarter consolidated sales of 30.97 billion, increased 8.1% from second quarter and 26% year-over-year from third quarter 2025. Next.

Now let's go down to see our gross profit. Consolidated gross profit of 12.67 billion in the quarter three this year, increased 4.2% quarter-over-quarter from second quarter this year and also up 42% year-over-year from a year ago. Next.

Let's look at our key financial margin, gross margin. Our gross margin of quarter three reached 40.89% in quarter three, down from 42.42% in second quarter this year, but up from 36.29% from a year ago. This result also met our guidance of 38.5 to 41.5%. Next.

Now let's look at our operating expense. Operating expense of 5.58 billion in quarter three, down 1.9% quarter-over-quarter from second quarter, but still increased 10.3% year-over-year from third quarter last year. Next.

Now let's look at our operating income. For quarter three, operating income of 7.09 billion, increased 9.6% quarter-over-quarter from second quarter and also increased meaningfully from last year by 83.7% year-over-year. Next.

Now let's look at our operating margin. Our operating margin of 22.87% in quarter three, increased from 22.56% in second quarter this year and also up from 15.70% a year ago. This result also exceeded our guidance of 19 to 22% for quarter three. Next.
Now let's moving down to see our net income. Net income for quarter three at 6.08 billion, down around 4% quarter-over-quarter, but increased 66% year-over-year from quarter three last year. Next.
Now finally, let's look at our bottom line the EPS. Quarter three EPS of 9.99, down from 10.40 last quarter, but up from 6.01 a year ago. Next.

Now let's look at the quarterly income statement for quarter three, compare with second quarter this year as well as quarter three last year, and also the quarter-over-quarter comparison, and the also year-over-year comparison. And you can see that the year-over-year comparison all are meaningfully across the major items.

This page show the accumulated results for our first three quarters for 2026, compared with the same period a year ago. And again, you can see the positive growth across all major items from sales, gross profit, and operating income and also net income.

For sales, first nine months up 6% year-over-year. Gross profit first nine three quarters up around 16% year-over-year. Operating income increased 22% year-over-year, and net income increased 27.8% year-over-year. Next.

Now let's look at our revenue breakdown for quarter three. For quarter three, the biggest segment remained SoC at 46% of overall revenue, down from 52% in second quarter. For small medium driver, the revenue was 37% in quarter three, up from 28% in second quarter. Large size driver only accounting for 17% of quarter three revenue, down from 20% in the second quarter.

We are also releasing our October revenues. October revenue of 10.05 billion, increased 27.6% year-over-year, but slightly down from September level. For the first 10 months, the cumulative revenue reached 92.8 billion, up 8.3% year-over-year. Also, we released the revenue breakdown for SoC, driver, and also some other accounts for October. Next.

This page show the monthly revenue trend from the beginning of 2025 until October this year, which we just released a number, and also to you can see the year-over-year comparison. The year-over-year tend to be positive since April this year and now is up to over 20% year-over-year compared with the same time a year ago. Next.

For this page, also show three key balance sheet numbers, the cash, account receivable, and inventory level. For cash, quarter three reached 40.6 billion. It's down from 25% quarter-over-quarter, but still up slightly year-over-year. The sequential decline is mainly caused by the distribution of cash dividend during the quarter three.

Account receivable of 22.7 billion, increased 11.4% quarter-over-quarter and 10.5% year-over-year, mainly due to the revenue growth. Lastly, on the inventory, inventory dollar of 18 billion, increased 35.7% quarter-over-quarter and 96.2% year-over-year.
Now let me pass the call back to David. Thank you.

Thank you, Tony, for the Q3 numbers. And here is a recap of a recent major events. Novatek has once again been ranked top 10 in the 2026 CommonWealth "Excellence in Corporate Social Responsibility Award". And on the social front, Novatek has walked extra mile and has been honored 2026 Outstanding Employer Award for Exceeding Disability Employment Quota. And also, we have also received the TOPS Taipei Procurement Excellence Awards. And we have a lot of other details on our ESG. Please visit our website for the most updated ESG report.
And now I'll turn over the call to our vice chairman Steve to provide us more details on Q3 results and Q4 guidance. 接下來我們邀請我們的王副董針對第三季的結果做進一步的說明，同時也報告第四季的展望。
各位線上的投資界的先進們，以及這個媒體界的朋友們，大家下午好。剛剛 Tony 呢，大概已經把我們第三季的結果，一些數字呢跟大家做了一些報告。第三季呢，我們的營收做了 309.7 億，309.7 億。那這個營收呢，較 Q2 呢大概成長了 8.1%，接近我們的 guidance 的上限。我想這最主要是因為手機的客戶呢，因為在備貨需求的旺季下呢，中小尺寸的這個出貨呢，較上一季有顯著的這個增長。
另外在 Q3 的毛利率呢，是 40.89%，比 Q2 呢下降了大概 1.53 個這個百分點。這個也符合我們的這個 guidance。以上大概第三季的結果大概是這樣說明。那第四季的這個展望呢，目前我們觀察到呢，由於受到這個 AI 基建排擠的這個效應呢，今年以來呢，memory chip 的供應緊缺，而且呢價格有大幅上漲。
那品牌的系統廠呢，在上半年呢提前進貨，同時呢調整了這個終端的售價。目前我們觀察到呢，第四季大尺寸面板的需求呢，看起來會進行這個庫存的調整。以及呢，在年底呢，通常客戶會有一些庫存的這個控管。受到這個影響呢，我們預期呢，這個 Novatek 第四季的營收呢，將進入這個季節性的這個調整。
目前來看的話呢，我們第四季的 guidance 呢，在營收上呢大概會做到 280 億到 292 億台幣，280 億到 292 億台幣之間。那這個是以匯率呢 1 比 32 來看。毛利率呢大概會介於 37% 到 39% 之間，37% 到 39% 之間。那營業利潤率大概會是在 17% 到 19% 之間。以上呢簡單跟大家報告一下有關這個第三季的結果跟第四季的這個展望。
Our third quarter revenue grew by 8.06% quarter-over-quarter, reaching close to the high end of our guidance. The growth was mainly driven by strong seasonal inventory build-up from smartphone

customer, which led to a significant increase in small- and medium-sized uh shipment. And the uh third quarter gross margin came in at 40.89%, down 1.53 percentage points from 42.42% in the previous quarter and which is also consistent uh with our guidance.

And as for 2026 Q4 outlook, uh AI-related inflationary pressures are weighing on consumer spending and will affect consumer electronics demand in uh 2027. Meanwhile, uh strong investment in AI infrastructure has created a crowding-out effect, leading to tight memory supply and rising memory price.

And following the inventory pull-in by brand and system customers in the first half of the year, along with price increases at the end-market level, we are now seeing weaker demand for large-size panels in the fourth quarter as customers tighten year-end inventory control. And as a result, uh we expect Novatek fourth-quarter revenue to enter a seasonal adjustment period.

And based on the above, our 2026 Q4 guidance will be as follows: Revenue will be from 28.0 billion to 29.2 billion. 28.0 billion to 29.2 billion at an exchange rate of 1 to 32. And the gross margins are guiding for 37 to 39% range. And operating margins from 17% to 19% range.

Thank you, Steve, for the uh Q4 guidance. Next, we'll move on to the Q&A sessions. And again, if you have any questions, you can uh uh you know uh upload to the our website our online and we'll try to review and organize and and ask the question for you.
Okay, now I'll turn over the time to uh Tony. And he already had some of the questions, we'll start from there.
Thank you, David. 那我們先就我們手上整理的一些問題開始發問。那第一個就剛剛管理層有簡單的提到一下這個第四季的 outlook 跟營收、毛利率的 guidance 等等。那想先請管理層就第四季公司幾個主要的應用需求的趨勢分享一下看法。

第四季各主要應用的需求的趨勢呢，我們的觀察呢大致如下。這個呢我們主要是以 panel 生產的 base 來看。以 TV 來講的話呢，大概 QoQ 看起來生產有這個減少的情形。那 monitor 這裡呢，QoQ 看起來是下滑的，monitor 這裡看起來是下滑的，QoQ。那 notebook 這裡呢，因為上半年品牌客戶的提前拉貨呢，QoQ 進入這個庫存調整。QoQ 呢看起來衰退是較大的，QoQ 看起來衰退是較大的。那手機這裡呢，我們看到的是中國客戶的訂單會略增，但是平板的季對季呢應該是會下降，平板是會下降。那以車載 auto 來看的話呢，QoQ 大致持平，QoQ 大致持平。
Could management share the view on the sequential trend across major applications in terms of order flow into quarter four this year?

Uh based on our observation of panel production trends across uh major applications in uh fourth quarter, uh TV and monitor production is expected to decline quarter-on-quarter. And uh notebook demand is expected to uh to decline QoQ as uh brand customers enter an inventory adjustment phase following a pull-in demand in the first half of the year.

Orders from Chinese handset customers are expected to increase slightly quarter-on-quarter, while tablet demand is expected to decline quarter-on-quarter. As for uh automotive demand, uh it is expected to remain broadly flat quarter-on-quarter.
剛剛管理層有給第四季營收的指引，那想請問一下三大產品線的營收季對季的表現，在第四季的情況怎麼樣？跟第三季相比。

剛剛跟大家報告了有關這個聯詠第四季的 revenue guidance 呢，在三大產品線來看的話呢，QoQ 都有不同程度的這個減幅。以中小尺寸來看的話呢，QoQ 呢營收是略減的。那這主要的原因是因為平板庫存的調整，需求下降。那非中國的手機的出貨部分呢，逐漸進入這個備貨的調整。雖然呢中國的手機的 OLED 的訂單呢有增加。那以 SoC 產品來看的話呢，業績減少次之。這主要是因為大尺寸面板相關產品的出貨下滑，但是面板以外的 SoC 的產品線呢，看起來應該是持平的。那以大尺寸來看呢，LDDI 呢，QoQ 的這個營收減幅較大。那最主要的原因是因為所有大尺寸應用的需求呢都衰退，特別是這個 notebook 的 panel。
Management already provided the revenue guidance for quarter four, but also wonder if you could provide your quarterly revenue trend across three business groups.

Well, in terms of the trends across uh Novatek three major product line in uh in Q4 and all three are expected to decline quarter-on-quarter in the different degrees. As for small-, medium- uh driver IC, uh we are expecting to decline slightly quarter-on-quarter uh representing the smallest decrease. And the uh tablet demand is weakening due to inventory adjustments and our ex-China customers are gradually adjusting their inventory builds.

While uh demand for OLED DDIC from Chinese handset customers is expecting to increase. As for SoC revenue, it is expected to decline quarter-on-quarter with the decrease somewhat larger than that of a small-, medium- driver IC and this is mainly uh due to lower shipments of products related to the large-size panel. While the uh non-panel SoC revenue is expected to remain broad broadly flat.

And uh for our large driver IC, uh we are expecting to see the largest QoQ decline among the three product groups. And this is uh basically reflecting the uh the weaker weaker demand across all major size large-size display applications, particularly uh the notebooks.
那想請問一下管理層目前對 2027 年的營收有初步的看法嗎？那特別是其中對於 DRAM 的價格、PC、手機終端市場出貨衰退的假設，或者有對特定產品線或客戶成長的一些想法嗎？
由於這個目前這個 memory chip 的價格呢仍處高檔，終端產品的售價調漲了，所以我們後續必須密切觀察對明年手機、PC 還有 NB 呢這個出貨的影響，還有市場的需求的這個挑戰。加上呢這幾天剛結束的美國期中選舉的之後呢，可能會有的一些的這個變變數。所以呢，明年呢我想聯詠在新產品上面呢我們也會持續推出不少這個新產品，相信呢營收的成長呢我們應該是可以期待的。

Could the company provide the preliminary thoughts on the revenue outlook for next year and also among them how about assumption for memory pricing, shipment growth of PC and smartphone, or even growth opportunities from particular product lines and the customers?

Given that memory chip price uh remains elevated and the end product prices have uh pretty much risen, uh we'll uh closely monitor the uh potential impact on the uh 2027 smartphone, PC, and notebook shipments as well as the related challenge to the market demand. And then, a few days ago, the results from the U.S. midterm elections uh could significantly alter 2027 market outlook. We'll keep a close watch on that.
But at the same time, uh Novatek um plans to launch several new products in 2027, which which we believe should support revenue growth.
公司上次的法說會 call 中有提到車用 TDDI 有大幅的增加，請問主要的原因為何？可以給提供一下月或季的出貨量嗎？那還有明年的展望，那也想了解一下公司在汽車產品的整體佈局。

今年以來呢，客戶採用聯詠車載的 TDDI 的 model 呢，事實上增加了很多。這個也代表說對 Novatek 產品性能的這個肯定。尤其是最近我們領先業界推出的 eDP 的 TDDI 呢，反應相當的好。這個將在呢第四季開始進入量產。我想對明年的營收應該也會有一些貢獻。除了 TDDI 以這種產品以外呢，Novatek 我們也持續推出一些新的產品。譬如說像 TED for 這個 P-HUD，就是 panoramic 的這個 head-up display。我相信對明年的營收呢，應該也可以提供一些成長的動能。

What are major factors for strong auto TDDI shipments you mentioned last time? Could you provide monthly or quarterly shipments figures, and also the outlook for next year, and your overall deployment for the auto product portfolio?

Well, what Steve just said is that the the increasing number of vehicle models adopting Novatek's automotive TDDI solutions uh reflects the uh customer's recognition of our product performance. In particular, our industry uh leading eDP TDDI has received positive market feedback and is scheduled to enter mass production in the fourth quarter of this year.

In addition to uh TDDI, uh Novatek also plans to introduce other new products including TED for PHUD, that's a timing-control-embedded driver for panoramic heads-up display applications and which are expected to provide additional revenue growth momentum in 2027.
公司今年在手機 OLED DDIC 似乎出貨量減少，請問原因為何？那請問一下明年在手機 OLED 產品的佈局與機會可以分享一下嗎？

聯詠的手機的 OLED DDIC 呢，今年的出貨量會有減少。這個最主要是因為全球手機的需求衰退呢，另外還有這個中國手機品牌市占的這個改變。主要原因是這個。那公司明年呢我們也會持續開發跟推出一些高性能、省電的這個手機的這個像 OLED DDIC 或者是 OLED TDDI。包括這個使用在折疊機高刷新率的使用的這個高階的產品。那除了手機以外呢，Novatek 我們也會推出 notebook、monitor 還有這個平板用的這個 OLED solution，來抓住未來這個 IT 的應用的商機。
What are factors for decline of your smartphone OLED driver IC in 2026? And also could you also provide some comments on the product development and opportunity for your OLED DDIC uh for next year?

The uh smartphone OLED DDIC shipments, well, is expected to decline year-over-year in 2026 and uh uh this is mainly due to a weaker global smartphone demand and also uh the changes in market share among Chinese handset brands. And um in 2027, uh Novatek will continue to develop and introduce high- high-performance, power-efficient smartphone OLED driver ICs and also TDDI OLED TDDI ICs, including high-end products for the uh foldable devices.
And additionally, uh beyond smartphones, uh Novatek is also introducing
OLED solution for notebook, monitors, and tablets to capture future growth opportunity in IT application.
那想請問在 SOC 產品中，公司延伸在圖形畫質的研發能力，從 TV SOC 到手機的 MEMC 或者所謂的獨顯，可以就製程的進展與客戶推廣上有所更新跟我們分享嗎？
Novatek 所開發的這個手機上用的這個獨顯 IC 呢，由於這個 performance 不錯，目前呢已經逐漸受到更多客戶的採用，特別是在這個遊戲的手機上。由於手機的應用講求性能還有功耗，因此呢我們的製程採用以先進的製程為主，主要是在 12 奈米或者是以下的這個製程為主。

As for SOC product, Novatek has leveraged the strong picture quality capability from TV SOC to MEMC for smartphone. Could you provide updates on customer penetration and no-process for your MEMC product?

The Novatek's high performance stand-alone MEMC, which is the motion estimation motion compensation IC, has been adopted by an increasing number of handset customers, particularly for gaming smartphones. And given the stringent performance and part efficiency requirement for the mobile applications, these products primarily use advanced process nodes of like 12nm and even below that.
想請問管理層對於 TTED，所謂的 Touch TCON embedded Driver 產品的看法。公司有計畫推出類似的產品嗎？
針對這個 touch notebook 的這個應用呢，事實上聯詠已經開發系列的產品呢，提供給不同客戶導入最好的這個使用體驗。明年呢這些的產品呢會陸續進入這個量產。
Could management provide a view on TTED product, TTED is including the touch TCON embedded driver, and will you introduce similar product in the near term?

For the touch-enabled notebook applications, basically Novatek has already developed a series of products tailored to the needs of different customers, and designed to deliver an optimized user experience. And these products are expected to enter mass production progressively in 2027.
接著有一些關於毛利率的問題。第一個是剛剛有提到第三季毛利率 40.9%，符合指引的 38.5 到 41.5%，但較第二季下滑，請問主要的因素為何？
我想那個第三季的毛利較第二季下滑呢，最主要的因素是因為第三季的這個出貨的產品組合呢不一樣，主要是 SOC 的這個營收佔比下降。另外當然也有部分的這個售價的調整呢反應這個成本的這個時間差呢，有這個時間差。
Third quarter gross margin of 40.9% met the guidance of 38.5 to 41.5%, but decreased from 42.4% in second quarter. What are major factors?

The factors include the decline in this, mainly due to Q3 product mix, particularly a lower revenue contribution from SOC product, as well as a timing gap between the cost increase and the corresponding selling price adjustment.
那公司提供了第四季毛利率指引與第三季相比，請問一下影響的因素為何？那也可以是不是就成本的增加還有售價的調整也稍微加以說明？
第四季這個毛利率的 guidance 呢跟第三季的差異呢，主要的影響因素是，第一個是第四季低價的庫存的成本呢會減少。第二個呢，第四季的銷售產品組合呢會有不同。第三個呢，由於這個 KGD 的成本漲幅大呢，這一部分呢可能會稀釋一部分 SOC 產品的這個毛利率。我想主要是三個原因。

Given the gross margin guidance for quarter four, what are the major factors to cause the sequential decline from quarter three? Would you also provide comment on cost increases and selling price adjustment?

Well, the fourth quarter gross margin is expected to be affected by the reduction in low-cost inventory, and secondly, the product mix, and last, the significant increase in KGD, known-good-die cost, which is the memory part. And this will weigh on or dilute our SOC gross margin.
那也想稍微再就這個再跟進一下，就請問一下您的 SOC 跟 DDIC 產品中，有哪些已經調整售價反應成本？
那這個所有的 SOC 和這個 DDIC 的產品呢，事實上我們已經適時依市場的情況呢，陸續調整這個售價來這個反映成本。
Which SOC and driver product have you raised selling price over since this year?
Well, we've been progressively adjusting selling price across all SOC and DDIC products as appropriately basically based on the market conditions to reflect the cost increase.
那也想請教一下關於供應鏈這邊晶圓跟封測這邊的明年 2027 年漲價的幅度是如何？那公司有如何應對的策略？
由於這個持續受到 AI 需求暢旺的這個資源排擠效應呢，目前看起來 2027 年部分晶圓跟這個封測的價格呢仍有上漲的這個情形。公司目前仍和這個供應商在協商中。公司呢會同時考量產業的長期健康發展呢，還有客戶呢做好這個溝通來適時這個動態反映。
By how much will foundry and packaging cost increase in 2027, and also how about your strategy to cope with this cost increases?

Again, due to the continuous crowding-out effect on supply chain resources from robust AI-related demand, prices for certain foundry, packaging, or testing services are expected to increase further in 2027. And Novatek will remain in discussions and negotiations with our suppliers. And at the same time, Novatek will maintain close communication with customers and responds dynamically with considering the long-term health and sustainable development of the industry.
想請問一下公司有預計明年 SOC 跟 DDIC 各自的毛利率可以維持在 2026 年的水準嗎？或 DDIC 產品較有壓力？或者整體 2027 年的毛利率可以維持在 2026 年的水準嗎？
我想那個追求營收的成長跟毛利率呢，一直是公司經營的這個兩大的重要目標。那目前觀察 2027 年的這個需求跟供應鏈呢，看起來仍具相當的這個挑戰挑戰性。那聯詠呢我們會持續透過開發新產品，還有優化這個產品的組合，特別是這個高階的產品，另外呢提升這個技術力以及控管成本呢來提升這個毛利率。

Could management, could Novatek maintain gross margin for both driver IC and SOC for next year compared with 2026? Or you are seeing more pressure on driver? And how about you can, could you maintain the overall gross margin for next year compared with 2026?
